root_cause.text: A signed comparison in `io_poll_get_ownership()` causes the cancellation flag (`IO_POLL_CANCEL_FLAG`, BIT(31)) in `poll_refs` to be interpreted as a negative number, so the slowpath threshold check (`>= IO_POLL_REF_BIAS`) always fails, preventing proper handling of cancellation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (unlikely(atomic_read(&req->poll_refs) >= IO_POLL_REF_BIAS))` to `if (unlikely((unsigned int)atomic_read(&req->poll_refs) >= IO_POLL_REF_BIAS))`, casting to `unsigned int` before comparison. The commit message explicitly states: "When IO_POLL_CANCEL_FLAG (BIT(31)) is set in poll_refs, the value becomes negative in signed arithmetic, so the >= 128 comparison always evaluates to false and the slowpath is never taken."
